decisions.reason: Its continued stand-alone presentation through 2019 suggests results close enough to aspiration levels and a strategic fit strong enough that a medium-sized established machinery firm would likely continue it rather than reallocate resources.

It remained visible after launch and likely benefits from portfolio complementarities in formwork systems, so even if performance is only moderate the firm likely keeps it while slack still covers this niche offer.
A dedicated product page in both observed years indicates stronger commitment and probably acceptable performance relative to aspirations, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.

Its lower prominence and probable overlap with other magnetic formwork products make it the most likely candidate for below-aspiration performance and for resource reallocation to stronger established or development projects.
